model.catLabel: Ryan Jr. Sod Cutter operations and parts manual MAN 4166212 (PDF)
model.note: Part outlines are traced from a Ryan studio image of the Jr. Sod Cutter with a Honda engine and are approximate. The V-belt, brake band, gear case and chains sit under the drive cover and are in the parts list. Part numbers come from operations and parts manual MAN 4166212 (2010, covers 544954C) and the Honda GX160 owner's manual; the 2022 unit (s/n 544954C10123) may have detail changes, so confirm the blade and rear tyre with Bobcat parts.

body.name: Drive cover and gear case
body.desc: The cover over the drive: A-section V-belt from the engine to the gear case, then roller chain to the drive shaft and blade. Gear case oil: EP 140 gear lube, 1.7 L (3.5 pints) total; check on the dipstick (sit the dipstick on the threads, don't screw it in) and only top up if oil has been changed or lost (the old Notion 'SAE 90 GL-5' is wrong). Gear case oil seals 1.00 in and 1.38 in shaft (548272 / 548954, 2 each). Drive chain #50 roller (assembly 547398, connector link 4117675, half link 548480) and #50 double chain in the gear case (546937): #50 is ANSI 50 (5/8 in pitch), stocked by the metre at bearing houses; do not use BS 10B, it looks similar but does not fit. Yearly: inspect the drive chain and sprockets and check the gear case for leaks.

belt.name: V-belt, idler and brake band
belt.desc: V-belt A-section 66 in (524582; any A66 belt fits). Engine pulley 4 in A-size 517137, idler pulley 3.25 in plain 548942. Every 6 months or 100 h check belt tension: with the master clutch engaged the roll-pin to sleeve gap on the clutch rod should be 25 to 30 mm (1 to 1-1/4 in); adjust by sliding the engine on its 4 mount bolts. The belt slips and wears if oily or under-tensioned: keep it clean. Brake band 524573 (kit 540274): no drag with the clutch engaged and it must stop the large pulley when the lever is pulled firmly back. If the engine stalls when the master clutch is engaged, the brake band is set too tight.

clutchrod.name: Master clutch rod
clutchrod.desc: Belt tension check point: with the master clutch engaged the roll-pin to sleeve gap should be 25 to 30 mm (1 to 1-1/4 in). Adjust by sliding the engine on its 4 mount bolts. Check every 6 months or 100 h.

guard.name: Front guard bar
guard.desc: Tighten loose nuts and bolts and replace missing cotter pins before use.

engine.name: Engine: Honda GX160
engine.desc: Honda GX160, 163 cc, 5.5 hp, recoil start, Oil Alert. Engine oil SAE 10W-30 API SJ or later, 0.58 L: change at the first month or 20 h, then every 6 months or 100 h (the old Notion '1.1 L, 50 h' is wrong). There is no oil filter on the GX160 (Notion's 15410-ZE1-000 row should go). Air cleaner: clean every 3 months or 50 h (more often in dust), replace the paper element yearly or 300 h; the element number depends on the air-cleaner type, so read the engine type code (e.g. GX160-K1QX2 / UT2) before ordering (Notion's 17211-ZE1-505 is not confirmed). Spark plug NGK BPR6ES (Honda 98079-56846, Denso W20EPR-U), gap 0.7 to 0.8 mm: check every 6 months or 100 h, replace yearly or 300 h. Clean the sediment cup every 6 months or 100 h; clean the spark arrester if fitted. Dealer items: idle 1400 rpm (+200/-150), valve clearance cold IN 0.08 +/- 0.02 mm, EX 0.10 +/- 0.02 mm (yearly or 300 h), fuel tank and filter clean, fuel tube every 2 years.

levers.name: Blade levers
levers.desc: Includes the blade pitch hand lever. Blade pitch 0 to 9 deg: use the flattest angle that holds depth; extreme angles stress the drive. Dull blades make the cutter ride out of the ground: sharpen before increasing pitch.

handle.name: Handlebar
handle.desc: Handlebar carrying the controls and cables. Before use check for loose fasteners and missing cotter pins.

controls.name: Controls and operator presence system
controls.desc: Daily operator presence test: engine running at half throttle and master clutch engaged, release the presence lever: the engine must stop. Do not use the cutter if it doesn't.

rearwheel.name: Rear wheel
rearwheel.desc: Rear caster: 8 x 1.75 semi-pneumatic in the 2010 manual, 9 x 3.50-4 in the current Bobcat spec: the 2022 unit may have either, check before ordering.

wheels.name: Drive wheels
wheels.desc: Drive wheel assembly 18 in, 547424.7, 2 per machine: 8 in diameter steel with knobby tread vulcanised to the hub, so there is no separate tyre (the old Notion pneumatic wheel and tyre rows are wrong).

blade.name: Blade
blade.desc: 18 in blade 4132717.7 (MAN 4166212, 2010; now Bobcat 4178003-18.7): confirm against the 2022 build with Bobcat parts before ordering. 12 in blade is 546182.7. Before use: bottom and side blades not cracked or broken; never weld or straighten a blade. Sharpen when dull: hand-file the bottom blade at 45 deg until no flat remains; keep the cutting edge under 1.5 mm (1/16 in) thick by grinding the milled surface back at 15 deg; same for the side blades; no burrs. Mole blade kits (options): 544670 / 544725 (3/4 in), 544673 / 544728 (1-1/4 in).

sidearm.name: Side arms and pitman arms (grease points)
sidearm.desc: Six grease fittings, lithium-based grease: pitman arms (1 each side) and side arms (1 each side) every 4 h of use, so at the start and halfway through a full day; side-arm pivots (1 each side, top of the unit) every 8 h. Pitman arm needle bearing 1.25 x 1.62 x 1.06 in (521428; likely the standard B-2017 drawn-cup size, check before ordering). Side arm ball bearing 521436, grease seal 521438, needle bearings 548138. Bronze bearing (bracket assembly) 521429. Yearly: inspect the side-arm and pitman bearings.

fueltank.name: Fuel tank
fueltank.desc: Unleaded petrol, max 10 % ethanol, 3.1 L. Check fuel before use. Fuel tank and filter clean is a dealer item (yearly or 300 h; Honda says every 6 months or 100 h).

4178003-18.7.note: Supersedes 4132717.7 per the catalogue note. No AU price found.

546182.7.name: Sod cutter blade 12 in
546182.7.note: Only for the 12 in machine: Sod Cutter 1 is 18 in.
